auth.why: To act on the user's tenancy: read move-related mail with permission, send demand letters, and track their cases.

description: Recovers wrongfully withheld rental security deposits. Detects moves, diaries each state's legal deadline, sends statute-citing demand letters on day one past due, and escalates to small-claims packets. Contingency: 25% of recovered funds.

proactive_triggers.description: Lease, mover confirmation, or USPS change-of-address email detected

tools.description: Open a deposit-recovery case after a move
tools.name: create_case

tools.description: Current status: deadline, days remaining/overdue, max recovery, next action
tools.name: get_case_status

tools.description: Generate the statute-citing demand letter PDF (only once the deadline has passed)
tools.name: generate_demand_letter

tools.description: Look up a state's return deadline, statute, and penalty multiple
tools.name: get_state_law

webhooks.case_deadline_passed: Fired when a tracked case's legal deadline passes; agent generates and queues the demand letter for user approval.
